subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should the fix be limited to making explicit `heartbeat.session` override wake-origin `forcedSessionKey`, or should this also change Telegram DM default session isolation?
rationale: The source-backed bug is the explicit heartbeat session losing to an originating session, while default Telegram DM isolation would change documented `session.dmScope=main` behavior for existing users.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win over wake-origin sessions, migrate or preserve system events safely, and leave default Telegram DM scope unchanged.

options.title: Broaden to DM default isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DM default session behavior as a product/compatibility project with docs, migration guidance, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Require fresh live repro first
options.body: Pause implementation until a current-main Telegram heartbeat/exec-event repro proves the problem still occurs outside source inspection.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Make explicit `heartbeat.session` win over wake-origin sessions, migrate or preserve system events safely, and leave default Telegram DM scope unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the adjacent merged Telegram dedupe boundary that this issue explicitly follows up on.
